annotations.title: Market risk brief: regime, stress gate and what happened next

description: What is the stock market today, in one call? Returns the live market regime reading, the stress gate, and the scorecard row for the current regime: what the S&P 500 did in the 5 and 20 trading days after past readings in this regime (typical return, how often it rose, a bad outcome as a drawdown risk measure). A cross-asset macro signal. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Recomputed hourly during the US session. Useful when an agent wants one reading as a risk check before a trade or as a position sizing input.
